title: Booking a table
instructions: Paul telefonda masa ayırtıyor ama bazı bilgileri değiştiriyor. Uzun bir diyalog; son kararlara dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: paul
script.text: Hello. I want to book a table for Friday evening, please.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: Of course. For how many people?

script.speaker: paul
script.text: For four people. Oh, wait. My brother can come too, so five.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: Five people on Friday. What time?

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: I'm sorry, we're full at eight. We have a table at seven or at nine.

script.speaker: paul
script.text: Hmm. Nine is late for my mother. Seven, please.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: OK. Do you want a table inside or in the garden?

script.speaker: paul
script.text: In the garden, please. My father smokes. No, sorry, inside. It's cold in the evening.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: No problem. Inside. Can I have your name?

script.speaker: paul
script.text: It's oh seven nine three, four five six, two one eight.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: Thank you, Mister Green. See you on Friday.

questions.prompt: How many people is the table for?
questions.feedback: Önce dört der, sonra kardeşi de gelebildiği için beş (so five) olur.
questions.evidence: My brother can come too, so five.

questions.prompt: Why can't Paul have a table at eight?
questions.feedback: Saat sekizde restoran dolu (we're full at eight).
Dokuz annesi için geç olduğundan yedide (Seven, please) anlaşıyorlar.

questions.prompt: Where are they going to sit?
questions.feedback: Önce bahçe der, sonra düzeltir: içeride (inside), çünkü akşam soğuk.
questions.evidence: No, sorry, inside. It's cold in the evening.

questions.prompt: Why does Paul change his mind about the garden?
questions.feedback: Akşamları soğuk olduğu için (It's cold in the evening) içeriyi seçiyor. Babasının sigara içmesi bahçeyi isteme sebebiydi.
